description: T0 and T1 runs of the same paired application suite. Both used the candidate-verification tooling changes recorded in worktreeStatus; no compiler or application source differed. Generated bytes are identical.

method.order: rotating cold order and warm starting variant; sequential workers
method.coldWall: whole worker startup, TS loading, input read, application, serialization, and output
method.coldCpu: process user+system CPU through result serialization/output; excludes final metric print and shutdown
method.warm: application call and top-level string flattening; excludes import, input read, normalization/hash verification
method.memory: maximum of cold per-process RSS high-water before normalization (applicationPeak) and after output (processPeak); includes Node/worker/import/input. Heap is a live snapshot including garbage, not retained or peak JS heap.
method.instrumentation: append only export { app_run } to an isolated generated copy; original emitted bytes hashed
method.baseline: handwritten matching algorithms/helpers with native Map/list storage; generated representation follows the selected backend. Actual T0 separately includes objects, regex, slice, and its full parser
method.limitations: one host; no actual M1, fixed point, OS cold-cache control, I/O durability workload, or concurrency test; checks are outside application timing
